'''B-T3 Guard Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. These [[Droid/Legends|droids]] patrolled the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] tower in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
B-T3 Guard Droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as enemies on Nar Shaddaa.
